description: Owner earnings by year (net income + depreciation + amortisation - capex, Buffett 1986) beside free cash flow as a cross-check, return on equity and on tangible capital, and, given a share price, the owner-earnings yield against the long bond, three value anchors per share (bond-equivalent, two-stage DCF on normalised and on latest owner earnings), a margin-of-safety ladder, a reverse DCF (the owner-earnings growth the price requires at 8, 9, 10 and 12% required returns) and a growth x required-return sensitivity grid. Returns refused with a reason, and no value, when fewer than three of the last five years had positive owner earnings, the latest year was a loss, or owner earnings exceed 1.6x actual free cash flow. Inputs from SEC filings; price supplied by the caller. Examples: {"ticker": "KO", "price": 70.1}; {"ticker": "CTVA", "price": 62.5, "long_bond_pct": 5.2, "hurdle_pct": 9}; {"ticker": "DE"} (history only).

long_bond_pct.description: Long-bond yield in percent (5.4 = 5.4%). Default: the latest 30-year Treasury par yield, fetched from treasury.gov

shares_millions.description: Shares outstanding in millions (default: the latest count on the company's filings)

ticker.description: US-listed ticker that files with the SEC, e.g. KO or BRK.B

name: owner_earnings_valuation
title: Owner earnings and reverse DCF
